title: KlearNow | Autonomous Customs & Trade Intelligence
description: Autonomous customs clearance and trade intelligence across five countries. KlearNow turns trade documents into filing-ready data with a full audit trail.
mainHtml:
Trade rules change
weekly.
Your data already knows.

KlearNow turns every filing into structured intelligence — then clears customs autonomously.
Your team touches only the exceptions.

What it was worth to importers last year

  • $51.7MSec 301 tariffs avoided
  • $49.5MSec 232 tariffs avoided
  • $1.331B+IEEPA tariffs avoided
Ask Klear a question
Trusted by the teams that keep global trade moving
THE KLEARNOW ECOSYSTEM

Three Layers.
One connected trade system.

KlearData powers KlearPlatform, which enables KlearServices. Each layer builds on the one below — a single coherent system, not a stack of disconnected tools.

Foundation

What’s included:

  • Data ingestion & normalization
  • Tariff & duty intelligence
  • Classification & trade-program data
  • Supplier & product-level insight

Fragmented customs, shipment, classification, duty, supplier and compliance data — ingested, normalized and made queryable. This is the layer nobody else has, because nobody else files.

Explore
Operating layer

Everything in Foundation, plus:

  • Autonomous clearance & filing
  • Track & trace + drayage
  • Exposure & landed-cost analytics
  • Exception-only human review

Connected workflows, visibility, analytics and control across import operations — with KlearAssist reading the data and doing the work. Exceptions route to your team; everything else clears itself.

Explore
Execution layer

Everything in the Operating layer, plus:

  • US & global customs brokerage
  • Post-entry audit & duty recovery
  • Managed trade compliance
  • Drayage & delivery execution

Technology-enabled customs, brokerage and managed trade services delivered at scale. Our own licensed team operates on the same data — which is why we can price and clear like software, not headcount.

Explore
The Agent

The work runs itself
You do the judgment.

KlearAssist reads the data, applies live CBP rules and executes — clearance, audit, drayage, recovery. What it can't decide alone comes back to you with context and a recommendation.

How we work

A clear plan for

Agreed priorities and delivery dates

We agree the priorities with your team and schedule work around your plans. Requests stay in a shared channel, with larger changes scoped before work starts.

Support for your supplier approval process

We work with your legal and finance teams on contracts, security questions and purchase-order billing. Our experience includes enterprise security reviews and corporate accounts payable.

Monthly reporting on results

Your report shows completed work, the results we can measure and the priorities we recommend next. Depending on the agreed scope, it covers search visibility, AI citations and conversions.
